INSERT INTO user_totp (user_id, secret_encrypted, nonce, key_id)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
                secret_encrypted = EXCLUDED.secret_encrypted,
                nonce = EXCLUDED.nonce,
                key_id = EXCLUDED.key_id,
                confirmed_at = NULL,
                last_used_step = NULL,
                created_at = NOW()
